provenance.typography.pairing: An editorial pairing is the posture's voice; the tenant's own faces stay brand-class and unreachable from here.
provenance.typography.scale: A slightly larger type step sets the record like a document, inside every vertical's type range.
provenance.typography.role-weights: Light role weights let the typography whisper rather than announce.
provenance.typography.numeric: Proportional figures read as prose, not as a ledger.
provenance.shape.radius-scale: Gently softened corners, inside every vertical's radius range.
provenance.shape.nesting: Concentric nesting keeps inner corners true to the outer ones.
provenance.shape.button-style: Soft buttons follow the radius posture rather than restating it.
provenance.shape.control-height: Tall controls give every field room to breathe.
provenance.density.mode: Spacious density is the posture's reading measure.
provenance.spacing.rhythm: An airy rhythm is the space around the content the posture is named for.
provenance.surfaces.elevation-posture: Flat surfaces keep the page a page.
provenance.surfaces.border-style: Hairline borders separate without drawing attention.
provenance.surfaces.effect-intensity: Effects turned almost off, as the posture's intent states.
provenance.states.emphasis: Subtle state emphasis: states that whisper.
provenance.states.focus-style: An underlined focus reads as quiet without losing the indicator.
provenance.motion.dial: Slow, low-intensity motion: unhurried and never ambient.
provenance.motion.character: Organic motion matches the editorial register.
provenance.navigation.sidebar-tone: A subtle sidebar recedes behind the document; it picks steps of the tenant's own ramps and carries no colour of its own.
provenance.profiles.expressive: The editorial expressive profile states the soft geometry, ruled edges and paper material as one posture.
provenance.recipe-profile: The editorial-round recipe is the component recipe that posture assumes.
provenance.chrome.anatomy: Underlined cards, ruled tables and a panel sidebar are the editorial anatomy.
provenance.responsive.posture: An expansive responsive posture keeps the reading measure at wide widths.
